# The Eastline New York

The Eastline New York (realny.vercel.app) is a modern luxury residential building located on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.

## Building Information

- Address: 1655 First Avenue / 355 East 86th Street, New York, NY 10028
- Architect: INC Architecture & Design
- Amenities Designer: Paul Duesing & Partners
- Developer: Chess / Sponsor
- Exclusive Leasing & Marketing: Real New York
- Features: Over 10,000 sq ft of private wellness and social amenities surrounding a central landscaped garden courtyard.
